q1.question: What's included?
q1.answer: You get the full Next.js source code with auth, Stripe, email, Drizzle ORM, dark mode, and i18n preconfigured. Everything you need to launch a SaaS.

q2.question: Do I need a Stripe account?
q2.answer: Yes. You'll need a Stripe account to enable payments. The boilerplate includes the full integration — you just add your API keys to .env.

q3.question: Can I use this for multiple projects?
q3.answer: The Pro License grants lifetime access for a single developer. The Pro Plan subscription gives you ongoing updates and priority support.

q4.question: What database does it use?
q4.answer: Neon serverless Postgres with Drizzle ORM. You can swap the database driver if you need to — the repo structure supports any Postgres-compatible database.

q5.question: Is there a refund policy?
q5.answer: If the boilerplate doesn't work as described, contact us within 7 days for a full refund. No questions asked.

cta.subheading: Join developers using this boilerplate to launch in days, not months.

q1.question: Is the Free plan actually free?
q1.answer: Yes. Clone the repo from GitHub and start building immediately. No credit card, no trial period, no expiry.

q2.question: What do I get with Pro?
q2.answer: Pro includes the full skill library (40+ skills), multi-tenancy module, AI features module, custom agents (11+), MCP server configs, premium skill packs, lifetime updates, private Discord access, and unlimited project seats.

q3.question: What's the difference between Free and Pro?
q3.answer: Free gives you the core boilerplate: auth, database, Stripe, email, file uploads, MDX blog, and 10 built-in Claude Code skills. Pro adds the full skill library, advanced modules (multi-tenancy, AI), custom agents, and lifetime updates.

q4.question: Do I need Stripe to use the boilerplate?
q4.answer: No. Stripe is optional. The integration is included but dormant until you add your API keys -- you can build and ship without enabling payments.

q5.question: What happens after I buy Pro?
q5.answer: You get immediate access to the full Pro source code and skill library on GitHub. It is a one-time payment -- no recurring charges.
